source_summary: Recent NFLX SEC filings converted into underwriting-oriented disclosure summaries.

fields.title: NETFLIX INC General SEC Filings
capital_markets_activity: Recent filings include debt issuance and financing-related 8-K disclosure.
capital_allocation_activity: Our other uses of cash include strategic acquisitions and investments, as well as share repurchases.

Stock Repurchases In September 2023, the Board of Directors authorized the repurchase of up to $ 10 billion of the Company’s common stock, with no expiration date, and in December 2024, the Board of Directors increased the share repurchase authorization by an additional $ 15 billion, also with no expiration date.
liquidity_notes: Recent 10-Q disclosures discuss liquidity needs and management's view of cash flow adequacy.
governance_notes: Recent 8-K filings include governance and board composition updates.
controls_and_risk_notes: Controls and Procedures (a) Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures Our management, with the participation of our co-Chief Executive Officers and Chief Financial Officer, evaluated the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Exchange Act) as of the end of the period covered by this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
